01 — About

I build full-stack products powered by AI.

I'm a Full Stack & AI Engineer with 5+ years of experience building scalable backend systems, full-stack web apps, and AI-powered products across fintech and enterprise. My core stack is Java, Python, TypeScript, React, FastAPI, Node.js, AWS, and Docker.

I've shipped production-grade REST APIs, microservices, and CI/CD pipelines across multiple companies. Lately I've gone deep on AI engineering — agentic workflows with LangChain and LangGraph, RAG pipelines, and vector search — and built Syntrix, an AI-powered ATS résumé platform, end to end as a solo founder.
